answer: An identity earns its seat through heartbeat variability entropy profile, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 15 minutes once; the operator of 379 fakes spends 5685 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. One quartz of signal, one kernel of cost, one jade of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
